continuous_text.title: What Color Is It?
continuous_text.content:
Yellow, purple, orange.
Think! Think! Think!
What color is it?
It's pink.

The door is red.
The board is white.
What color is the clock?
It's blue. Tick Tock!
continuous_text.notes: Audio tracks 019 and 020. Includes alternative color substitution prompts: brown, green, gray.

continuous_text.title: Billy's Painting
continuous_text.content:
Frame 1
Narrator: The children are in the classroom. Here's the teacher.
Teacher: Hello, children!
Children: Hello!
Teacher: Let's paint!

Frame 2
Billy: What is it?
Ava: It's a desk!

Frame 3
Ava: No! It's a chair.

Frame 4
Narrator: This is Ava's painting.
Ava: It's a cabinet. It's yellow.
Billy: It's good, Ava.

Frame 5
Narrator: This is Billy's painting.
Billy: It's a door. It's red.
Ava: It's very good!

Frame 6
Ava: Oh, no! I'm sorry, Billy!
Billy: Oh, no!

Frame 7
Narrator: Billy has an idea.
Billy: It's OK, Ava!

Frame 8
Billy: Look! It's a window.
Ava: It's fantastic!
Teacher: Good job, Billy!
continuous_text.notes: Lesson 4 Story spanning pages 12 and 13. Teaches resourcefulness when mistakes occur.

continuous_text.title: School in My Country
continuous_text.content:
This is my school. It's yellow. The door is blue.
This is my teacher. The board is green.
This is my classroom. My desk is brown and gray.
This is the playground. Look! Eight students!
continuous_text.notes: Lesson 5 Reading passage formatted as a poster project by Carlos from Cuba.

schema_gaps.observed_content: 'Think, Feel, Grow' section on page 13 ('Why is Ava sad? Why is Billy OK? Share your ideas') explicitly linked in the syllabus (p. 3) to 'Emotional Well-being: Being resourceful'.
schema_gaps.problem: The current schema lacks a dedicated structure for social-emotional learning (SEL) / values objectives and prompts, forcing it into generic component or activity structures.
schema_gaps.proposed_change: Introduce an optional 'social_emotional_learning' or 'values' object within unit or lesson components containing 'theme', 'target_competency', and 'discussion_prompt'.
schema_gaps.reason: Explicit values and emotional well-being strands are central to modern young learner curricula and lesson planning.
